D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that the next Neighborhood Safety meeting will be held
on June 7, 2023 at 6:00 pm.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an update on the active construction projects.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that pool will open on May 27
and May 28; there will be a Memorial Day Event on May 29; and the Teen Center will host a pool party on
June 9.

Councilmember Roa spoke.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, announced that the Governor signed AB 341, which extends the existing
Card Club moratorium for 20 more years.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa reported that he attended the Contract Cities Conference.

Councilmember De Paula reported that he attended the Contract Cities Conference; and attended the
closing program for youth sports.

Mayor Pro Tem Farfan congratulated Gina Zietlow and the new ABC Unified School District
Superintendent; reported that he attended the Contract Cities Conference; and attended the closing
ceremony for mini soccer.

Mayor Del Rio reported that he attended the Contract Cities Conference.

Councilmember Vargas reported that he attended the Contract Cities Conference.
